0022600197.text: The Detroit Pistons (6-2, 1st in the Central, 3rd in the East) host the Los Angeles Lakers (8-2, 1st in the Pacific, 3rd in the West), with Detroit at home at 2-1 and coming off a loss in its last game after a 6-2 stretch over its last ten. Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Los Angeles is missing Luka Doncic (back soreness) and enters on a four-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Pistons won both games in the 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently beating the Lakers 113-110 in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
